items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: So Papa got all the, let me see, Saeed, Mercedes Fields in the little town. And Harrison Burrett, myself. And Eddie Pearson, yeah, to come play, to play at the American Legion Hall.

ctx.x: Well, I was going to ask, in the Celestan's band, did you join him when he had more than one band? Sometime I heard he had a band that played at the paddock and then wanted to be out on the road sometime. Do you remember those days?

Yes, in a way, I did because we started, I started with him at, let me see, it was at the American Legion Hall on Ross Street. Well, Bill Matthews and them were supposed to play there with him. And it seemed like they already stayed at the paddock lounge and played. It was a count of a day. So Papa got all the, let me see, Saeed, Mercedes Fields in the little town. And Harrison Burrett, myself. And Eddie Pearson, yeah, to come play, to play at the American Legion Hall. So, so we played there. I know there was a…
Were you there with the band when Shatz played for the South Stand Kid Shatz?
